Backend Engineer (Python) — Bengaluru, Full-time

We're a 40-person B2B SaaS startup building workflow tools for logistics companies.

What you'll do
- Design and build REST APIs in Python (FastAPI) used by thousands of daily users
- Own PostgreSQL schemas, migrations and query performance
- Run background jobs on Redis-backed queues
- Write tests and review your teammates' code

Must have
- 3+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong Python, including async code
- Solid SQL and PostgreSQL experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have
- Docker and AWS experience
- Experience with LLM APIs or ML systems in production
- Open-source contributions

You must be authorized to work in India.
